system: Assign only the missing responsibilities of attached assets in this H3 request. Interpret the complete user request semantically, not from a keyword list. Keep every supplied role and replacement description exactly unchanged. A frame anchor is an actual frame; a subject/style/environment/storyboard is a content reference. A structure video lends camera/cutting, not its people or world. An edit_source video is the clip being edited; continuation_source supplies the clip being continued. A placed_subject picture adds without removing; a replacement_subject picture replaces a figure in the edit-source clip. The picture's identity survives; the removed figure transfers position/actions/timing and loses appearance. Music style, rhythm, timbre and sound texture reference properties; bgm copies the signal. Asset.Description is caller commentary and never observed evidence. If a role was omitted and the user names a replacement figure explicitly in the intent, you may extract that exact phrase into replaces; do not invent or paraphrase it. Do not fill an existing blank replaces on an explicitly declared role. Return only the exact schema. Mode is already selected and immutable.

facts.text: The image is a character reference sheet arranged as a large hero panel at the top, three full-body turnaround panels in the middle row, and four close-up detail panels along the bottom.

The hero panel shows a single adult person standing on a wet rooftop or industrial walkway at night, with metal railings on both sides, rain streaks, reflective ground, dark buildings, and blurred city lights.
The person has short dark hair with shaved sides and a small topknot, and wears a black high-collared tactical-style jacket, a black top, black pants, and black lace-up combat boots.
In the hero panel, the person stands with the body facing forward and the head turned toward the left side of the frame.
The FRONT panel shows the same person standing upright, facing the camera with arms at the sides.
The SIDE PROFILE panel shows the person standing in profile, facing toward the left side of the frame.
The BACK panel shows the person from behind, standing with arms at the sides, revealing the jacket back, pants, and boots.
The FACE close-up shows the person facing the camera with a neutral expression; a small mark is visible above one eyebrow.
The JACKET COLLAR close-up shows a high black collar with strap and metal buckle/hardware details.
The HANDS close-up shows the person’s hands with relaxed fingers and visible skin texture.
The BOOTS close-up shows black lace-up combat boots with worn-looking leather and dark laces.
Legible labels on the sheet are HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

limitations: The sheet is a still image, so motion and sound are not observable.

facts.text: The image is a composite creature reference sheet showing one dark dragon design: a large cinematic scene across the top, three labeled full-body view panels in the middle row, and four labeled close-up detail panels in the bottom row.

The large top image shows a black, heavily scaled, quadrupedal dragon with a long pair of pale horns, multiple head and neck spines, large membranous wings, and a long tail, positioned low on rocky ground beside shallow reflective water.
The background of the top image is a dark volcanic landscape with jagged rock formations, a hazy sky, and warm orange ember or fire glow in the distance.
The middle row contains three full-body views: a front-facing view with wings spread, a side-profile view with the body extended and wings extended backward, and a rear-facing view with wings spread.

The bottom row contains four detail images: a close view of the horned head with a visible orange eye, a view of the dark veined wing membrane, a close view of a clawed foot with large curved talons, and a close view of overlapping dark scales with faint blue-green sheen.
Legible labels appear beneath the panels, reading FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, REAR, HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.
The dragon’s design uses charcoal-black and slate-gray scales, bone-colored horns and claws, dark membranous wings, and small orange eye highlights.
The sheet has a dark-fantasy concept-art style, with cinematic lighting in the top scene and neutral dark backgrounds behind the isolated view and detail panels.

limitations: The image is a still reference sheet and provides no evidence of motion, animation, camera movement, sound, music, or dialogue.
The dragon’s exact species, size, scale, and biological details cannot be determined from the image.
Some background and shadowed anatomical details are obscured by darkness and haze.
